title: The Pilgrim Road
text: Little shrines line the road by the hundred, each with a candle burning in a niche for someone who did not finish this journey. The newest has no name on it yet. Its candle is unlit.

options.label: Light a candle at every shrine, so none who fell here are left in the dark.

outcomes.text: It takes all day. The road feels lighter after, the unlit candle burning with the rest.

options.label: The most devout prays at the newest shrine, for whoever it is waiting for.
Walk past without stopping; the dead can light their own candles.

outcomes.text: One by one, the candles go out as you pass, all the way down the road.
